source2='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    perimeter = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                 if r == r0 or r == r1 or c == c0 or c == c1]
    outer = max(set(perimeter), key=perimeter.count)
    core = [(r, c) for r, c in points if grid[r][c] != outer]
    if not core:
        return out
    inner = max(set(grid[r][c] for r, c in core), key=lambda color: sum(grid[r][c] == color for r, c in core))
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r, c in core), max(r for r, c in core)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r, c in core), max(c for r, c in core)
